default.question: How do I get Fieldnote into my calls?
default.answer: Connect your calendar. I’ll join every call that has a customer on the invite, and you can turn that off per meeting.

default.question: Do I have to take notes?
default.answer: No. I transcribe as you talk and mark the moments that match your tags, so you can just listen.

default.question: How do I share what we learned?
default.answer: Pick the clips that matter and I’ll build a reel with a summary. Send the link to anyone, even without a seat.
